en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim who said, 
‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘What is a right of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> upon His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures?’
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘That they should be saying what they know, and they should be pausing from what they do not know.
So when they do that, so they would have paid to Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, His<sup>azwj</sup> Right’.
en.sarwar: 12. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim who has said the following. “(Imam) abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) said, ‘
People must say only what they know and hold back from what they do not know.
If they would do as such they have observed the rights of the Lord upon them.’” This he said in answer to a question from Hisham ibn Salim.
